correctness.rationale: The compatible probability measure has moments exactly equal to Fubini numbers; its unit restriction supplies a uniformly convergent Mahler series. The exact finite 81-residue certificate gives leading coefficients with v3(M0,1)=2 and v3(M1,1)=1, while all higher terms satisfy strict higher divisibility after the binomial-difference estimate. The resulting 3-adic distance identities are proved for all arguments and imply both full residue-ball images and exact fibers. Modulo 3 parity checks and the nonunit error bound handle small indices; finite tests are supplementary only. A self-contained checker verifies 5,374 exact assertions.

broader_coverage.reasoning: A known eventual period fixes the total number of indices in a block, not its output-image cardinality, surjectivity or individual fibers. The universal shift-defect formula also does not entail the sharp two-branch isometry; a separate leading-moment proof is needed. Neither stronger coverage nor domination of the claim is established.

value.rationale: The 2019 mod-nine pattern was merely a local obstruction; the theorem proves its exact converse for all powers of three, classifies multiplicities of every attained residue and exhibits sharp 3-adic distance laws for both index parities. This resolves a natural infinite-level image invariant and yields an explicit nontrivial Haar measure 4/9. It is not a renamed known period or a finite table recomputation.
